title: Handle unknown corner radius without safety claims
description: Permit editing and output when corner radius is unknown while returning a persistent visible diagnostic and explicitly withholding any corner-containment conclusion.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown radius remains distinct from zero, known, and estimated radius in domain and UI state
Editing, preview, and PDF preparation may continue when no other blocking violation exists
A visible diagnostic states that corner containment cannot be concluded from unknown geometry
No validator, preview mask, success message, or preparation labels unknown corners as safe, contained, verified, or calibrated
The unknown-radius assumption and diagnostic are retained in the print preparation

steps.details: Carry the TASK-52 unknown-radius result through content-region validation, diagnostics, and preparation input without substituting zero or an estimated value.
Add a non-blocking but persistent corner-uncertainty diagnostic that is separate from known geometric violations and uses evidence-safe wording.
Show the diagnostic beside geometry controls, in label/sheet diagnostics, during PDF preparation, and in preparation inspection.

steps.description: Verify allowed output and withheld conclusion
steps.details: Generate from an unknown-radius fixture, assert output is available absent other violations, and inspect persisted assumptions/copy for prohibited safety claims.

technicalNotes: Timebox to propagating one confidence state and one diagnostic through existing seams.
Allowing output is not an override and does not establish corner safety.
